title: The Five-Fold Cosmos and the Five Great Matters Revealed
description: If one of the five worlds were missing, the cosmos could not stand: the cosmos is held in being only by its complete five-fold structure, sustained by the bearing-power (Omophoros) and the manifest substance of the Lord (Sophia / Mother of Life). Against this, the Apostle reveals five great matters by which the elect come to know their origin in Light, the aeons, the Darkness, the boundary of death in the flesh, and the binding of those who cover over the Good.
